name: Pro Fin Capital Services Ltd.
about: Pro Fin Capital Services Ltd. provides financial services in India. The company trades in securities. It also provides capital market services comprising equity trading and investment, portfolio management, market research and analysis, real-time market insights, and risk-adjusted strategies; and derivatives and commodities services consisting of currency derivatives trading, futures and options, commodity trading, hedging strategies, and market timing analysis. In addition, the company offers short-term finance services, such as short-term loans and working capital finance; and advisory and reports services, including investment advisory, arbitrage trading strategies, market intelligence reports, risk assessment, and financial planning. Pro Fin Capital Services Ltd. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
